summary: Benchmark reference answers (bench/sql reference queries, saved receipts, synthetic data) that the governed metric for each question reproduces on artifacts/agere-healthcare-v123/stack; the oracle metric/slots are in oracle.json.

K01.question: How many of our patients carry a heart failure dx? CHF, HFrEF/HFpEF, systolic or diastolic, whatever — I just want the headcount.

K03.question: quick one - how many pts have ever had an A1c of 6.5 or higher? any A1c result counts, dated or not, however the lab named it

K04.question: Quality gap check: how many hypertensive patients have never had an LDL cholesterol result come into the system? Don't count pulmonary hypertension.

K05.question: Pull everyone who has had an eGFR under 30 at any point. Only use the BSA-normalized eGFR results (mL/min/1.73m²) — skip any GFR reported in plain mL/min.

K06.question: For the weight management program sizing: how many patients have obesity documented on the problem list? Include BMI 30+/40+ codes and E66 codes, but not 'overweight' and not history-of entries.

K09.question: How many patients have had an LDL >= 190 at any time? Thinking about possible familial hypercholesterolemia screening.

K10.question: Pharmacy safety huddle: how many patients have had a potassium over 5.0 drawn so far this year?

K13.question: What was our ED utilization per 1,000 members for calendar 2026? Use the whole roster as the denominator.

K14.question: Inpatient admits by half-year for 2026 — H1 vs H2. Don't count obs stays.

K15.question: For the practice scorecards: 2029 YTD ED visits broken out by each patient's attributed primary care practice.

K16.question: Of the ED visits in 2026, how many got an in-person clinic follow-up within 7 days? Phone calls and telehealth don't count.

K17.question: care mgmt wants frequent ED flyers - how many patients had 2 or more ED visits in the last 12 months?

K18.question: Monthly urgent care visit counts for Jan through June 2029, please.

K19.question: Rev cycle question: what's our initial denial rate on medical claims for benefit year 2028? Count a claim as denied if it was ever denied, even if it got paid on resubmission.

K21.question: Finance wants net payer paid dollars on medical claims for benefit year 2028, by payer. Make sure reversals net out.

K22.question: How much did patients pay us in 2028, split by payment channel (cash vs ACH vs card)?

K23.question: Pharmacy ops: in 2028, how many prepared fills went back to stock without being picked up, and why?

K24.question: What was the no-show rate for appointments scheduled in 2028? Only count appts that actually had an outcome (showed or no-showed).

K26.question: Data engineering here — how many lab result rows came in with no collection date at all?

K27.question: What's the average lag, in days, between collection date and when the lab result landed in our warehouse, for results that arrived during 2028?

K29.question: How many encounters are missing a visit date entirely?

K33.question: Among our heart failure patients, how many reported food insecurity on a social needs screen?

K35.question: By insurance type, how many patients told us they have trouble paying for medical care?

L01.question: Quick one for the board deck: how many hypertensive patients are we managing? Count anyone with HTN on the problem list, however it was coded.

L02.question: Pull me the list of diabetics whose most recent A1c is 8 or above — that's our 'not at goal' outreach list.

L03.question: How many women between 50 and 74 do we have on Medicare or Medicaid? Sizing a mammography outreach.

L06.question: Familial hypercholesterolemia screen: how many patients have EVER had an LDL of 190 or higher?

L08.question: Peds asthma registry size — how many kids under 18 have asthma?

L09.question: How many CAD patients do NOT also carry a heart failure diagnosis? Trying to size a secondary-prevention clinic separate from the HF clinic.

L10.question: Pharmacy safety question: how many patients had a potassium above 5.0 at any point so far this year?

L11.question: Women with a hemoglobin under 10 in the last 12 months — how many? (Hemoglobin, not A1c.)

L13.question: ED visits by month for Jan through Jul 2029?

L14.question: ED visits per 1,000 members by payer type over the trailing 12 months. Use the whole roster in each coverage group as the denominator.

L15.question: Urgent care volume by quarter, Q4 2028 through this quarter (partial is fine).

L16.question: How many hospital stays — admits plus obs stays — started in the last 12 months?

L17.question: Give me the frequent-flyer list: anyone with 2+ ED visits in the past year.

L18.question: What % of our hospital discharges in the last 12 months got a follow-up visit within 7 days?

L19.question: ED visits per 1,000 attributed patients by PCP practice, trailing 12 months. Which practices are running hot?

L21.question: Average inpatient length of stay in days for completed admissions?

L22.question: Unduplicated headcount: how many patients used the ED or urgent care (either one) in the past 12 months?

L23.question: CFO wants net payer dollars received on claims for 2028 dates of service — net of any takebacks/reversals.

L24.question: First-pass denial rate by payer for 2028 dates of service?

L25.question: How many claims got denied and then we eventually got paid on them (overturned on resubmission/appeal)?

L26.question: Pharmacy abandonment: for 2029 so far, how many prepared fills went back to stock, broken out by reason?

L30.question: How many claims bounced at the clearinghouse in 2028 because of a bad member ID?

L32.question: Controlling high BP: of hypertensives with a BP on file, what % have their latest reading under 140/90?

L33.question: Statin therapy for CAD — what % of our coronary disease patients filled a statin in the last 12 months?

L34.question: Kidney health evaluation for diabetics, 2028 measurement year: % of diabetics 18-85 who got BOTH an eGFR and a urine albumin-creatinine ratio during 2028.

L35.question: GDMT check: what share of the HF panel picked up an evidence-based beta-blocker in the past year?

L36.question: Statin use in diabetes (ages 40-75): percent who filled any statin during calendar 2028.

L37.question: Data engineering sanity check: how many lab result rows came in with no service date at all?

L43.question: Transportation barriers vs. missed appointments — how many patients flagged a transport problem AND have at least one no-show?

L44.question: Financial strain by payer type: among people we've screened, what share reported trouble paying for care or medical bills?

M17.question: For ED visits this year, what percent got any outpatient touch — office, PCP, specialist or a phone call — within 7 days after?

M18.question: Phone encounter volume by quarter for 2028?

M19.question: Primary care visits in 2028 broken out by each patient's attributed practice.

M20.question: How many patients haven't had a primary care visit in the last 12 months?

M23.question: Of claims for 2028 dates of service that were denied on first pass, how many have since been overturned and paid?

M24.question: How much did payers actually pay on 2028 dates of service, net of any takebacks?

M27.question: Billed vs allowed vs paid by service type for 2029 dates of service — current state of each claim, please.

M28.question: Median days from date of service to first payer cash for 2028 services?

M29.question: What's our total outstanding patient A/R right now?

M31.question: Diabetes control measure for 2029: percent of diabetics 18-75 with their most recent A1c this year under 8.

M32.question: Controlling high blood pressure, 2029 YTD: % of hypertensives 18-85 whose latest BP is under 140/90.

M37.question: Data quality: for each lab source system, how many lab rows came in without a collection date and what % is that?

M38.question: How timely is the lab feed this year — what share of 2029 results landed more than 3 days after the event date?

M40.question: How many appointments are sitting in 'booked' with a date that's already passed?

M42.question: How many patients have flagged a transportation problem on any social needs screen?

M44.question: Community referrals: by service type, how many did we send and how many actually got delivered?

N01.question: How many diabetics are on our books? Type 1 or type 2, and count anyone coded with a diabetic complication (kidney disease, neuropathy, microalbuminuria). Don't count prediabetes or gestational diabetes.

N02.question: Give me the list of patients whose latest eGFR is under 45 and whose latest urine albumin/creatinine ratio is 30 or above. Those are the ones nephrology wants to see first.

N04.question: How many patients are on insulin of any kind? Check the med list, orders and pharmacy side.

N05.question: Which heart failure patients have no beta-blocker anywhere in their medication records? I want names to review for GDMT gaps.

N08.question: Possible undiagnosed diabetes for HCC/outreach review: patients whose most recent A1c is 6.5 or higher but who have no diabetes diagnosis on their problem list.

N09.question: Anyone with an LDL of 190 or higher on file? Doesn't matter when it was drawn — I'm looking for possible FH.

N11.question: Bleeding-risk check: which afib patients have both an anticoagulant and an antiplatelet on record?
